Definition: Simulation time. observation_2D.dat: days since simulation start (BASE runs start at day 1; EXTRA runs continue from day 2190; SEEDS runs restart at day 0). observation_columnSpinup.dat: days since spinup start.
Total liquid + ice water content integrated over the subsurface domain (ATS variable water_content; extensive integral).
Ponded surface water content integrated over the surface domain (ATS variable surface-water_content; extensive integral).
Snowpack water content integrated over the surface domain (ATS variable snow-water_content; extensive integral).
Snow depth averaged over the surface domain (ATS variable snow-depth).
Snow density averaged over the surface domain (ATS variable snow-density).
Surface evaporative flux averaged over the surface domain (ATS variable surface-evaporative_flux); negative values indicate condensation.
Surface evaporative flux integrated over the surface domain area (ATS variable surface-evaporative_flux; integral). Summing daily values gives total evaporated volume.
Evaporation drawn from the subsurface integrated over the surface domain area (ATS variable surface-subsurface_evaporative_flux; integral).
Surface water flux leaving the domain through the surface outlet region (ATS variable surface-water_flux; extensive integral over region 'surface outlet').

Water exchange flux between surface and subsurface integrated over the surface domain (ATS variable surface-surface_subsurface_flux); negative = flow from the surface into the subsurface (infiltration). Divide by 55500 mol m-3 to convert to m3 d-1.
Snowmelt rate averaged over the surface domain (ATS variable snow-melt).
Snowmelt rate integrated over the surface domain area (ATS variable snow-melt; integral).
Rainfall rate averaged over the surface domain (ATS variable surface-precipitation_rain); equals the synthetic rainfall forcing column for the run's sigma level.
Rainfall rate integrated over the surface domain area (ATS variable surface-precipitation_rain; integral).
Snowfall rate (snow water equivalent) averaged over the surface domain (ATS variable snow-precipitation).
Snowfall rate integrated over the surface domain area (ATS variable snow-precipitation; integral).
Ground surface temperature averaged over the surface domain (ATS variable surface-temperature).
Air temperature forcing averaged over the surface domain (ATS variable surface-air_temperature).
Depth from the ground surface to the top of frozen ground averaged over the surface domain (ATS variable surface-thaw_depth).
Depth from the ground surface to the water table averaged over the surface domain (ATS variable surface-water_table).

Net surface water flux through the surface outlet region (ATS variable surface-water_flux; extensive integral). This is the hillslope runoff analysed in the manuscript. Divide by 55500 mol m-3 to convert to m3 d-1.
Molar density of liquid surface water averaged over the surface domain (ATS variable surface-molar_density_liquid).
Total area of the surface domain (ATS variable surface-cell_volume; extensive integral).
